title: Merge duplicated config parsers
prompt:
config.py has two parsers with near-identical token handling: one for
'key=value' lines and one for 'key: value' lines. Merge them into a single
implementation, parse_kv(text, sep), and keep both public wrappers.

Requirements:
- parse_kv(text, sep) parses text into a dict.
- parse_equals(text) and parse_colon(text) keep their names and signatures and
  must delegate to parse_kv.
- Behaviour must not change: blank lines and lines starting with '#' are
  skipped, surrounding whitespace is stripped from keys and values, the first
  separator splits, later separators stay in the value, and a line without the
  separator is an error.

Only config.py should change.
